chunk.title: THE HUNGRY FOX STUCK IN THE TREE HOLE
chunk.text: Join Kids Heart Family  Tia, Tia  Hey Tofu, guess what?  I just bought a remote driven car from Hull.  What? Why?

chunk.title: THE HUNGRY FOX STUCK IN THE TREE HOLE
chunk.text: He said he wanted to sell his car.  I said I will buy it.  He gave me a good deal on it too.  Have you ever seen this car Tofu?  No, but what could be wrong?

chunk.title: THE HUNGRY FOX STUCK IN THE TREE HOLE
chunk.text: Well, nothing, but it is always nice to know what you are getting into.  Oh, you worry too much Tia.  Maybe, but the Hungry Fox learned the other way.  What do you mean?  The Hungry Fox stuck in the tree hole.

chunk.title: THE HUNGRY FOX STUCK IN THE TREE HOLE
chunk.text: Once upon a time, a Hungry Fox roamed in the forest.  He was very hungry and there was no food to be found.  There is no food anywhere today.  I shall go to the outskirts of the forest where the village starts  and see if there is something to eat there.

chunk.title: THE HUNGRY FOX STUCK IN THE TREE HOLE
chunk.text: The Fox walked to the edge of the forest and entered the village area.  There he found a big tree with a hole in its trunk.  Curious, he looked into the hole.  Wow! There is food in there.  Bread, fresh jam, fruits.

chunk.title: THE HUNGRY FOX STUCK IN THE TREE HOLE
chunk.text: The food had been stored by a villager who was farming nearby.  The Fox quickly jumped into the hole in the tree trunk  and ate everything that the farmer had kept there.  Music  That was a good meal.

chunk.title: THE HUNGRY FOX STUCK IN THE TREE HOLE
chunk.text: My stomach is full now.  But I am thirsty.  Time to go and drink some water from the river.  The Fox got ready to jump out of the tree trunk  but as much as he tried, he couldn't.

chunk.title: THE HUNGRY FOX STUCK IN THE TREE HOLE
chunk.text: He was stuck in it.  His stomach was now so fat that it got caught in the hole  and he could not come out of it as much as he tried.  Oh no! I am stuck.  The villager will come back anytime and I will be in so much trouble.

chunk.title: THE HUNGRY FOX STUCK IN THE TREE HOLE
chunk.text: I wish I had thought a little before eating all that food.  I think I am behaving like the Fox dear.  Yes, you've got that right.  Giving your action some thought before you jump in  can go a long way in helping you out.

chunk.title: THE HUNGRY FOX STUCK IN THE TREE HOLE
chunk.text: You are right.  Tomorrow before I pay hall for the car  I will request him to show it to me.  Good idea.  Now please help me refill the watering can.
